items.title: PDF to Text Extractor - PDF Parser & PDF to Markdown
items.name: pdf-text-extractor
items.description: Extract text from PDF URLs or base64 files with this PDF extractor and PDF parser. Get per-page text, PDF to Markdown, or RAG chunks; optionally extract tables and OCR scanned pages.

pdf-extracted.eventDescription: Flat fee per PDF (download + metadata + structure).

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: Bulk OCR: Image & Scanned PDF to Text from CSV or Google Sheet
items.name: bulk-ocr-image-pdf-to-text
items.description: OCR every image and scanned PDF linked in an Apify dataset, CSV, Excel or Google Sheet, keeping your columns. Inputs: datasetId or fileUrl or fileUrls, urlField, languages. Adds text, confidence and page counts. Tesseract inside the run, no outside service. Charged per page. Agent-ready: x402, MCP.

page-ocr.eventDescription: One page (an image counts as one page) read by OCR that produced at least one word. Blank pages are free.

page-text-layer.eventDescription: One PDF page copied exactly from its own text layer instead of being recognised.

file-export.eventDescription: One downloadable CSV or Excel file of the results.

webhook-delivery.eventDescription: The run summary delivered to your webhook, charged only on a 2xx response.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: PDF OCR Extractor — scanned PDFs to text (Arabic + English)
items.name: pdf-ocr-extractor
items.description: Turn scanned or image-only PDFs into structured text that keeps its reading order: per-block bounding boxes, per-block OCR confidence, column-aware ordering, and a spatial plain-text rendering. Arabic and English OCR built in. Pay per document plus per page.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

document-processed.eventDescription: One PDF successfully downloaded and read.

ocr-page.eventDescription: One scanned or image-only page rasterized and passed through OCR.

text-page.eventDescription: One page read from the PDF's existing text layer — no OCR needed.

items.title: OCR Image to Text - OCR PDF & Screenshot to Text
items.name: image-ocr-extractor
items.description: Convert image to text or screenshot to text from public URLs. OCR PDF pages, scans, and photos with Tesseract; get recognized text and confidence scores in dataset records.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: PDF to Text API | Document Extraction for LLMs & RAG
items.name: pdf-text-converter
items.description: Convert bulk PDF documents via URL into clean, raw text. The perfect document scraper for LLMs, vector databases, and RAG pipelines.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: PDF to Text Extractor with OCR — Scanned & Digital PDF API
items.name: pdf-text-extractor
items.description: Extracts text from PDF files by URL: digital PDFs keep their text layer, scanned pages are read with OCR. Returns the full text, page count and metadata (title, author, ISO dates) as JSON. Failed URLs are never charged. For RAG engineers, agent builders and legal researchers.

pdf-processed.eventDescription: Text and metadata extracted from one PDF. URLs that fail (dead link, not a PDF, encrypted, oversized) return {ok:false} records and are never charged.

ocr-page.eventDescription: One scanned page read by OCR. Born-digital pages are never charged this event.

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: Scanned pages that need OCR now cost $0.015 per page. Born-digital PDFs are unchanged at $0.003 per PDF and never incur the OCR charge.

items.title: PDF Text Extractor - Bulk PDF to Text & Metadata
items.name: pdf-extractor
items.description: Extract text and metadata from any PDF URL in bulk. Get page content, author, title, creation date, and more. Detects scanned PDFs that need OCR. Perfect for document analysis, research, and compliance.

items.title: OCR & Document Extractor – PDF & Image to Text, JSON, Word
items.name: ocr-document-extractor
items.description: Convert scanned PDFs and images into clean, structured text in bulk. Export to JSON, Markdown, DOCX, TXT or HTML with tables and layout preserved.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

apify-default-dataset-item.eventDescription: Charged for each file downloaded and hashed

items.title: OCR Text Extractor - Images & Scanned PDFs to Text
items.name: ocr-text-extractor
items.description: Extract text from images (PNG, JPG, TIFF, WEBP, BMP, GIF) and scanned PDFs with Tesseract OCR in 28 languages. Per-page text, confidence scores, optional word boxes, automatic text-layer detection for born-digital PDFs. No API key, no browser. JSON, CSV, Excel.

page.eventDescription: One page recognised (an image counts as one page; a PDF is charged per page processed). Failed downloads and unreadable files are never charged.

items.title: PDF to Text API — Extract PDF Text to Clean JSON for LLM & RAG
items.name: pdf-text
items.description: Extract clean, structured text from any PDF by URL, page by page. Returns one row per page with de-hyphenated, whitespace-normalized text. Fast, no setup.

pdf-page.eventDescription: Charged once per PDF page whose text is extracted.

items.title: PDF to Text – Extract Text From PDF, Page by Page
items.name: pdf-page-text-extractor
items.description: Extract text from any PDF URL, one row per page. Pages with no extractable text (scanned PDFs) are never charged — the main differentiator. pypdf parsing, no OCR. Clean JSON for RAG pipelines, researchers and automation.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

page.eventDescription: One page of extracted PDF text. Only charged when the page actually has extractable text.

items.title: PDF to Text & Markdown: Extract PDF Content by URL
items.name: pdf-text-extractor
items.description: PDF text extraction by URL: PDF to plain text or Markdown for a list of PDF URLs. Extract selected pages, split PDF text by page for chunking. Rebuilds headings and best-effort tables for a RAG pipeline, an LLM or Google Sheets, via API or n8n. No OCR: scanned PDFs are flagged, not charged.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

document.eventDescription: Charged once per PDF successfully extracted, covering up to 20 pages. A miss (bad URL, not a PDF, over the 50 MB limit) and a scanned PDF with no text layer are never charged.

page.eventDescription: Charged once per extracted page beyond the first 20 in a single document.

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: The per-run start fee is increasing to cover the platform and proxy cost of runs that return no results.

items.title: PDF to Markdown & Text Extractor
items.name: pdf-to-markdown
items.description: PDF to Markdown converter and PDF text extractor for RAG and AI agents, including scanned PDFs via OCR (7 Latin-script languages). Convert a public PDF to text or page-aware Markdown with metadata, links and simple tables; OCR reads image-only pages instead of only flagging them.

pdf-processed.eventDescription: Charged only after a usable PDF extraction or clean image-only report is saved to the dataset.

ocr-page.eventDescription: Charged per scanned or image-only page that OCR turns into at least 20 characters of text; failed or skipped pages are free.

items.title: PDF Text Extractor – Bulk PDF to Text & Markdown with OCR
items.name: pdf-text-extractor
items.description: Extract text or clean Markdown (headings, lists, tables) from PDF URLs in bulk, or from every PDF linked on a web page. Metadata, page ranges, per-page or per-document output, OCR for scanned pages, RAG chunks. Full .md/.txt files saved to the key-value store.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

pdf-page-extracted.eventDescription: One PDF page read from the text layer (Markdown or plain text).

ocr-page.eventDescription: One scanned page read with OCR (instead of a text-layer page).
